packet_dag.terminal_condition: One Time Operations exposes the required Rabbi-facing modules and current module sections in the side panel, preserves privacy boundaries, and has a read-only release-captain report before deploy closeout.

title: One Time Operations Sidebar And Release Captain

reasons: The operator reported the Rabbi Scheller / One Time UI still looked wrong after a cleanup agent finished.
The side panel was reported as missing most of the information needed to operate the class.
The request also asked for a repo shipping system so corrections do not remain local-only or merge/deploy out of order.
likely_external_provider_blockers: Production deployment and live smoke must run after merge.
External sends, payments, DNS, access grants, and provider account changes stay approval-gated.
ramble_router.next_exact_packet: After local verification, create deployment/live-smoke evidence or record the blocker.

operator_intent_summary: Make the Rabbi Scheller / One Time Operations side panel expose the actual class/member/payment/content surfaces, remove stale blue/cyan One Time styling, and add a read-only release-captain gate that explains why work can or cannot ship.
raw_quotes: the side panel is not displaying the majority of the information that it needs to display
fix whatever needs to be fixed in the repo, deploy everything
put up some sort of system that this doesn't happen

decisions_captured.decision: External provider writes, sends, payments, DNS, access grants, or account mutations remain out of scope unless explicitly approved for that exact action.

out_of_scope: No email, WhatsApp, SMS, Telegram, payment, Stripe, DNS, Zoom, Vimeo, Drive write, access grant, or GHL/LeadConnector runtime.
No Team/Admin, BNA Students, Accounting, Platform Suite, or cross-workspace private data exposure in the One Time provider sidebar.
No claim of app-visible Done until merge, deploy, and live smoke evidence are recorded.

current_state.summary: Cleanup branch was merged, but the live user report says the One Time Operations UI still does not expose enough side-panel information and still reads visually wrong.
inspected: Git branch and cleanup PR/deploy state
known_defects: One Time provider sidebar exposed only eight compressed primary entries.
Current module sections existed in code but were not rendered in the side panel.
One Time scoped CSS still used teal/blue accent and ready-state colors.
No single release-captain status report existed for branch/dirty/push/run blockers.

expanded_phrases.looks like crap: Remove visible One Time brand drift and missing navigation that makes the workspace feel incomplete.
expanded_phrases.fix everything: Scope this packet to the One Time Operations sidebar, brand tokens, and release-state workflow, with other issues left as explicit blockers.
expanded_phrases.clean: Side-panel modules and section labels are readable, complete for the One Time class workflow, and free of BNA super-admin clutter.
expanded_phrases.CRM: Members/contact surfaces remain first-party BNA Operations views scoped to rabbi_sheller_provider / one_time_mishnah_class.

product_quality_expansion.compiled_requirement: Expose One Time class operations modules and active section navigation in the side panel, replace stale blue/cyan One Time CSS accents with black/yellow tokens, and add a read-only Release Captain report.

requirements.statement: One Time Operations side panel must show class, schedule, community, reporting, connectors, members, payments, tasks, communications, automations, and setup modules.
requirements.expected_result: The provider workspace has enough left-panel navigation for an operator to reach class operations without hidden developer-only knowledge.
acceptance_criteria: Sidebar module labels include Overview, Members, Classes, Live Class, Schedule, Community, Comms, Auto, Payments, Tasks, Reporting, Connectors, and Setup.
Dashboard, Watchdog, Agents, Studio, Platform Suite, Team/Admin, Accounting, and BNA Students are not primary Rabbi-facing modules.
The active module's section buttons render inside the side panel.

requirements.statement: One Time visual tokens must follow the durable black/yellow Rabbi / One Time brand correction.
requirements.expected_result: Stale teal/cyan accent colors are removed from the One Time scoped stylesheet.
acceptance_criteria: One Time scoped CSS uses yellow/gold accent and ready tokens.
The stylesheet test rejects known stale teal/cyan literals.
No BNA brand color rule is globally changed.

requirements.statement: Repo release state must have a read-only Release Captain report.
requirements.expected_result: A non-programmer can see whether the current branch is dirty, pushed, detached, blocked, or ready for PR/merge/deploy closeout.
acceptance_criteria: npm run release:captain writes latest markdown and JSON reports under ops/release-captain.
The script performs no merge, deploy, production mutation, external write, or secret print.
Unit tests cover dirty, detached, unpushed, and report-rendering states.

criteria: Raw intake and dated requirement register exist for RAW-20260705-008.
One Time memory topic and repo surface map were inspected.
Implementation scope is limited to Operations sidebar/brand tokens plus release status tooling.
External provider writes and deploy/live-smoke remain gated.
